name: studio-loops
title: Loop and ping-pong motion
description: A small helper that adds looping or ping-pong (there and back) motion to a GSAP timeline for exactly as long as a clip lasts, like Resolve 21's loop and ping-pong keyframe modes. Finite repeats, so the timeline length stays right.
usage: <script src="compositions/lib/studio-loops.js"></script>  then  StudioLoops.add(tl, "#badge", { y: 0 }, { y: -20 }, { start: 1, end: 9, cycle: 1.2, mode: "pingpong", ease: "sine.inOut" });
